name: Jacez Walton
strengths: Walton shows elite contact balance — breaks/bounces first tackle and keeps churning through arm tackles.
Walton runs with patient crease vision — lets blocks develop, then plants and finishes through the hole.
Walton keeps pad level low and finishes falling forward for extra yards on nearly every tackle.
Walton's between-tackles power fits a physical committee role for a 5-11 / 205 frame.
weaknesses: Walton's burst is functional more than home-run gear — limited featured pass-game usage on sophomore tape.
comparison: Walton comps to Ke'Shawn Vaughn — 5-10 / 214 mold who won with pad level and contact balance over elite long speed (size-matched to Walton's 5-11 / 205 frame).
projection: Walton projects as develop in the RB room, earn early committee and special-teams work, then compete for featured committee touches — starter upside as a physical between-tackles committee back.
schemeFit: Walton fits gap/downhill committee packages as a pad-level hammer and short-yardage finisher.
insiderNotes: Walton is a pad-level hammer with contact balance through first tackle, patient crease vision, and finishes falling forward. Between-tackles grinder — functional burst more than home-run gear.
staffNotes: Vault film desk verified 2026-08-19 from Central 2025 sophomore Hudl. Comp size-matched within ~1–2" — not a Florida-alum default.
